entries.title: Renamed: Setlist Prophet, models become Forbin v5–v10
entries.notes: Phish Setlist Predictions gets its real name. The models are the Forbin line now, after the Colonel — same models, clearer lineage. Same address; nothing to re-link.

entries.title: Forbin v10: occasion-aware
entries.notes: A curated residency does not avoid recently-played songs, so the rotation-state term switches off on special nights — v9 was scoring below plain frequency there. Those nights also run 27.1 songs against 21.1, so the odds rise 40% to match. Calibration on occasion nights goes 1.56 to 1.24.

entries.title: KPI dashboard rebuilt on 100 simulations
entries.notes: Six models over 100 held-out shows, 1994–2026. Forbin v10 836, v9 828, v7 806, v8 765, v6 699, v5 592, against 309 for chance. Reserved slots settled as a 41-song loss. Full patch notes now live on the page.

entries.title: "Random" is now "Chance" — and base Claude gets its own number
entries.notes: The baseline bar was never a model, just the arithmetic of 20 blind draws; it now says so. The genuinely untrained number sits beside it: picks made from model knowledge alone scored 10 of 40, against 7.7 for darts.

entries.title: Dev Log opens
entries.notes: Every public project now posts its patch notes here. Tiles filter the wire; outside projects publish their own feed and get merged in.

entries.title: v5: inline player, six Lab pies, a real phone pass
entries.notes: Any track plays right on the page via phish.in streams, with seek and auto-advance through the set. Six pies chart each night's songs — debut era, album, gap, originals vs covers, writing credits, the Marshall factor.

entries.title: Boards regenerated on v9
entries.notes: Rotation state applied to 2026 form; the full song pool restored — a curated residency does not avoid recently-played songs; the encore call moves to A Day in the Life.

entries.title: Moved to /setlistlizard-with/
entries.notes: Outgrew a card in the projects list. Old links redirect; the short address reads better.

entries.title: Credits & FAQ page
entries.notes: phish.in credited on every page for audio, durations, tags and banter — their one condition for the API. Prev/next pagers now sit above the setlist too.

entries.title: v9: calibrated odds + rotation-state term
entries.notes: Reserved slots removed. Beats v8 48 shows to 19 across 100 simulations; the five-model, 100-simulation verdict recorded in bot-wars.

entries.title: Backtest KPI dashboard
entries.notes: 10 held-out shows, 4 models, 40 blind runs — plus a per-band comparison chart.

entries.title: Show pages rebuild themselves
entries.notes: A workflow regenerates every show page and the tour stats whenever the feed or the generator changes, then hands off to the deploy.

entries.title: Oddities: sandwiches, fests and deep bustouts
entries.notes: Tour-wide counts, with fest legs excluded from sandwich counting.

entries.title: Canonical-host guard fixes the vanishing photos
entries.notes: The site answered on two URLs and the photo key only trusts one. The wrong host now redirects before a single request is wasted.

entries.title: Track links, real durations, tag chips, stage banter
entries.notes: Show pages pull the phish.in track map, plus retroactive show notes and per-song listen links for the MSG retrospective nights.

entries.title: Honesty pass: live scores separated from fitted
entries.notes: Every count verified against Phish.net; #96 rebuilt on real 1996 data; hindsight-built scores withdrawn; bot-wars section added.

entries.title: v2: song pages, venue map, rotation matrix, energy curves
entries.notes: Every song gets its own page, the tour-wide Lab arrives, show pages draw an energy curve, and the page generator joins the repo.

entries.title: v2 beta: the Deep Water look
entries.notes: A second face for the whole trip app — new stylesheet, ten new features, an extras pack. The offline mode shipped, broke photos site-wide, and was reverted within the hour.

entries.title: v1: tour dashboard + a page for every show
entries.notes: Interactive tour dashboard, per-show pages, the archive wired to them, tour stats surfaced. Also: an encore is not a set.

entries.title: Renamed: Setlist Lizard ... With
entries.notes: Phish Live Setlist gets its real name and moves house; old links kept redirecting.

entries.title: Live scoring debuts during #94
entries.notes: Picks scored in real time as the setlist lands; played nights backfilled as scored records; run-wide scorecard across all played nights.

entries.title: v6 and v7, rebuilt on real Phish.net data
entries.notes: A sourced rationale under every pick, called shots (opener, encore, bustout, longest jam), backtest head-to-heads, and the weighted 10-pick setlist game.

entries.title: Predictions page goes public
entries.notes: Model v5, the consensus barbell, published after 100k simulated shows — boards for the remaining MSG nights, with its own tile on the projects page.

entries.title: Tides, directions, flight status, AllTrails
entries.notes: NOAA tide strip on every day card, tap-for-directions on every drive, live flight-status and boarding chips, and verified AllTrails links with corrected distances.

entries.title: Live setlist page ships
entries.notes: The live board polls the bot's feed every 60 seconds during shows; the archive keeps every show after.

entries.title: Weather on every day card, a photo for every stop
entries.notes: Per-day live forecast with clothing tips, Google Place photos per stop, drive times on every leg, and per-person packing tabs.

entries.title: Deploys move to GitHub Actions
entries.notes: Push to main mirrors the repo to the site in about 100 seconds.

entries.title: Setlist section added to the front page
Trip app live at supmaine.mikeside.com
entries.notes: The whole app in a single file.

entries.title: mikeside.com opens
entries.notes: Domain, hosting, SSL, and the Stage Left theme.
